# launch80/B65

**Qwen3.8-27B at 71.8 tok/s on one Arc Pro B65 — a baked INT4 checkpoint that stock vLLM XPU loads without weight patches.**

**Use it if:** You have an Intel Arc Pro B-series card and want a measured, quality-gated Qwen3.8-27B setup on vLLM XPU with MTP or DFlash2 speculative decoding.

Built by **launch80** · Contributors: Wrapzii.

A single-card Arc Pro B65 32 GB project that speeds up batch-1 decode by making the model read fewer bytes per token. The INT4 lm_head and INT4 MTP draft layer are baked to disk in the body's GPTQ INT4 g128 layout (published as Launch80/Qwen3.8-27B-GPTQ-Int4-baked), and a runtime patch limits the draft to the first 32,768 vocabulary rows. Decode went from 24.7 to 71.8 tok/s in the shipped config on vLLM 0.27.2 XPU (BetterBench, single stream). A later INT4-baked DFlash2 drafter reaches 96.7 tok/s on a Swift-1.5 bake with vLLM 0.30.0. The repo also includes the quality gates (perplexity, paired GSM8K, greedy invariance), the bake tooling, and a 3-bit GEMV kernel the author measured and rejected.


**Host:** Author's box: Core Ultra 7 270K, 30 GB RAM, B65 in a chipset PCIe 4.0 x4 slot (decode reads VRAM, not the bus). On a host with several Intel GPUs, pass the render node by PCI address (GPU_BDF); ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0 alone can select the wrong card.

**Quick start:**

```sh
vllm serve Launch80/Qwen3.8-27B-GPTQ-Int4-baked --quantization gptq --dtype float16 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-num-seqs 32 --max-model-len 32768 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":6}'

```

**Known issues:** 

- With MTP on, the engine dies under concurrent load unless the GDN mixed-split patch is applied (on by default in the repo's launchers).
- MTP emits garbage on prompts under about 8 tokens, even with the stock fp16 head and no patches.
- logprobs and prompt_logprobs return NaN whenever MTP is enabled; run perplexity with speculation off.
- Hybrid GDN models fail engine start at vLLM's default max_num_seqs of 256; use 32.
- bake/serve-baked.sh at commit 43e02c1 reads $HERE before setting it, so under set -u it exits with 'HERE: unbound variable' unless DFLASH_DIR is set.

**Notes:** Builds on SergiioB/intel-arc-pro-b70-inference-cookbook (pinned image, MTP patches, base checkpoint, crash fix). The README says the cookbook patches are not redistributed, but commit 43e02c1 added patch_mtp_nightly.py, patch_mtp_boundary.py and patch_gdn_mixed_split_v5.py to patches/. The card is firmware-capped at 200 W / 2400 MHz. 71.8 is decode-only with short prompts; the author reports ~48 tok/s end-to-end through a coding agent at 21k context. The baked-v2 checkpoint (73.5 tok/s) has not been through the quality gates. An embed-INT8 derivative (bake/bake_embed_quant.py) frees ~1.15 GiB for KV cache on a 24 GiB B60.
